title: PR body's committed-capture shasum claim is false at af26d8a: zoom-01-zoomed-panned.png changed this round (blob dad6cbd1 -> ee2425fe) and hashes 9c1f806f, not the claimed 3b28c414; the re-capture is unclaimed
evidence:
PR body: "The PP_CAM_E2E captures are byte-identical across the addition (sha
63524a77 / 3b28c414)."  shasum -a 256: "63524a772ab30d72b780b5db84a32ac2305970c71c40e10d2048a2ed51a40227  docs/captures/v2-camera-zoom/zoom-00-fit.png" / "9c1f806fa9442bbf2f0cba84763c8ad403a05dfc429a7b28bde6117e51beea69  docs/captures/v2-camera-zoom/zoom-01-zoomed-panned.png". r3 diff blob: "index 00000000..dad6cbd1" (zoom-01); r4 diff blob: "index 00000000..ee2425fe" (zoom-01). The only re-capture note (lines 137-141) covers the r2 W5 fix, not the r4 B1 fold.
detail: The fold claim doc asserts a mechanical evidence sha that does not match the committed artifact; the B1 pan-clamp fix moved the converged pan target, so the zoomed capture changed — changed without claim or explanation.
recommended_fix: Re-run shasum on the committed zoomed capture, update the PR body's sha (and note the r4 re-capture under the B1 fold), or re-capture deliberately and document it.

title: PR body's pixel-diff percentages are stale: mechanical recomputation on the committed captures gives 66.1% differing pixels, not the claimed 61.4%/61.7%

checked)". PIL RGBA per-pixel comparison of the two committed 1280x720 PNGs: "pixels differing: 66.1%".

title: Carry-forward R3-W2 unfixed: the pullback_yields app7 leg still drives effect_settings_adjust on a zeroed App, persisting to the real ~/.pp-settings.bin on every test run
evidence:
app7: App
	pullback_test_app(&app7)
	...
	arm_pullback(&app7)
	effect_settings_adjust(&app7, &app7.input, rnd.SETTINGS_ROW_PULLBACK, 0)
	effect_settings_adjust ends: "settings_save_app(app)"; settings_save_app: "p := app.settings_path_override
	if p == "" {
		p = settings_path()". Live-confirmed: "-rw-r--r--@ 1 moses staff 7 23 Aug 11:44 /Users/moses/.pp-settings.bin" rewritten by the verification test run.
detail: The zeroed fixture has no settings_path_override, so every 'odin test app' run (local and CI) writes the dev's real settings dotfile with auto_pullback OFF — a test escaping its sandbox.
recommended_fix: Set app7.settings_path_override to a temp path (the exec-level adjust-test pattern) before the toggle.

title: Carry-forward R3-W3 unfixed: pullback_feed's spawn-event mapping caps at 8 ids and silently returns on a 9+ spawn frame, skipping the pullback
detail: camera_newest_terminals stops at len(ids)=8; a genuine seed in a large catch-up burst never pulls back, silently. Unreachable via current data (interval 80 vs 5-tick frame cap) but the interval is balance.json data.
recommended_fix: Size the buffer to the max same-frame spawns, or clamp n_spawns to 8 and map the newest ids (newest-first walk keeps the newest seed correct).

title: Carry-forward R3-W4 unfixed: the W7 same-window exclusion's correctness silently depends on terminal_spawn_interval_ticks (80) exceeding the 5-tick frame cap — unasserted
evidence:
window_lo := ids[n_spawns - 1]
	window_hi := ids[0] + 1 — core/catalog_test.odin:43: "terminal_spawn_interval_ticks": 80. No assertion of interval > max ticks/frame anywhere in the diff or worktree.
detail: At interval <= 5 two spawns land in one frame; the frame-level exclusion then diverges the view classification from plan-time (false SEEDs). Inert today, wrong when the data moves.
recommended_fix: Assert the invariant where balance loads (interval > max ticks/frame), or derive the exclusion window from the interval instead of the frame slice.

title: Carry-forward R3-N1 unfixed: the stale-latch guard can synthesize a Mouse_Release every frame when placement is armed while the pan latch is stranded
evidence:
poll: "} else if pan_latch_stale(inp.panning, rl.IsMouseButtonDown(.LEFT)) {
		append(&inp.events, Device_Event(Mouse_Release{pos = pos, button = .Left}))"; mouse pan branch gate: "} else if inp.panning && !drag_eff && placing_eff < 0 {" — the latch clear (line 387) sits inside that branch.
detail: With placement armed, nothing clears the latch (the pan branch is skipped), so a synthetic release is appended every frame; a synthetic release into the placement branch risks an unwanted placement commit.
recommended_fix: Clear inp.panning in the stale-guard branch itself before appending the synthesized release.

title: Carry-forward R3-N4 unfixed: start_run's pan-latch reset (app.input.panning = false) remains untested
evidence: start_run: "	app.input.panning = false // v2-camera-zoom: a fresh run closes any stray pan latch"; grep -rn "start_run" app/*_test.odin app/input/*_test.odin returns nothing.
detail: The lifecycle test pins release, begin_draw, modal, and the suppress branch; deleting the start_run reset keeps every gate green.
recommended_fix: One app-level pin: arm the latch, call start_run, assert panning == false.

title: Carry-forward R3-N9 unfixed: Pan executor still has no draw guard — a two-finger touch pan fires mid-draw, unlike the mouse path (!drag_eff gate); co-fire neither suppressed nor declared intentional
detail: mouse_map emits Pan only when no draw is active; the executor routes every Pan intent unconditionally, so a second finger during a touch draw pans mid-gesture (worst case: preview jitter).
recommended_fix: Suppress Pan while inp.drag.active in the executor, or declare the co-fire intentional in the comment.

title: Carry-forward R3-N10 unfixed: wheel residue advances before the ownership decision — NOC-scrolled/modal-blocked wheels pre-charge the accumulator a notch
evidence:
poll: "	if w := rl.GetMouseWheelMove(); w != 0 {
		notch, residue := wheel_accumulate(inp.wheel_accum, w)
		inp.wheel_accum = residue"; effect_zoom's .Noc_Scroll/.Blocked branches ("case .Blocked:
		return") never touch wheel_accum.
detail: Residue consumed as Noc_Scroll/Blocked persists; the first map scrolling after leaving the panel fires one notch early. Cosmetic bias, never a spontaneous zoom.
recommended_fix: Reset wheel_accum to 0 when the policy consumes a notch as Noc_Scroll or Blocked, or accept + document the carry.

title: Carry-forward R3-N11 unfixed: camera_newest_terminals (the W4 fix's core proc) still has no direct unit pin — found<n bail, >8 spawns, dead-id skip, event<->id ordering unpinned
evidence: "camera_newest_terminals :: proc(topo: ^pp.Topology, n: u32, ids: []u32) -> u32 {"; grep -n "camera_newest_terminals" app/render/camera_test.odin app/pullback_test.odin returns no test references — only the definition site and the feed-level call.
detail: The walk's only coverage is the feed-level test; its edge behaviors are unpinned despite being the W4 fold's load-bearing mechanism.
recommended_fix: Direct unit pins on camera_newest_terminals: interleaved junction after the terminal, 0-found, dead ids, newest-first order.

title: The r4 briefing's expected B1 e2e proof is absent: no scripted pan exercises the clamp near the 4.0 band edge — the CAM_E2E drag deliberately avoids it and both unit mirrors use 1.0/2.0 targets
detail: The round briefing's lens-guard expects a scripted pan converging past the band edge to clamp; no such artifact exists. The two unit mirrors do bite, so this is coverage shortfall, not a wrong clamp.
recommended_fix: Add a mirror at cam_zoom_to = 4.0: an unclamped pan delta past the max-band edge asserts the clamped target.
